    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    colors=sorted({v for r in g for v in r if v})
    def bbox(c):
        idx=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        return (min(i for i,j in idx),min(j for i,j in idx),max(i for i,j in idx),max(j for i,j in idx))
    b={c:bbox(c) for c in colors}
    area=lambda b:(b[2]-b[0]+1)*(b[3]-b[1]+1)
    oc=max(colors,key=lambda c:area(b[c])); ic=[c for c in colors if c!=oc][0]
